transcript:
Caller: The duplicate fee on my statement is still unresolved.
Representative: I can send a note to billing.

Caller: I still have not had the extra charge corrected.
Representative: Billing will receive your message.

Caller: Please call me to confirm whether my intake form arrived.
Representative: I will note that.

Caller: Can somebody phone me back about receipt of my submitted form?
Representative: I have your message.

Caller: Can you check which number is in my contact record?
Representative: I will check and call you back this afternoon.

Caller: Please verify my listed phone number.
Representative: I will review it and return your call later today.

Representative: The line on your statement is a credit, not a second charge.
Caller: I understand now. My question is answered and I need nothing else.

Representative: That amount was refunded yesterday.
Caller: I can see it now. This is resolved, thank you.

Automated message: This is a promotional advertisement for office supplies. No response is requested.
Representative: Unsolicited promotion; no customer request.

Automated message: This is an unsolicited marketing recording, not a service request. No reply is needed.
Representative: End of advertisement.

Caller: My address correction is still unresolved.
Representative: I have saved the corrected address now.
Caller: It is correct on my screen. This is fully resolved, thank you.

Caller: The address problem has not been fixed.
Representative: Please refresh; the correction has now been applied.
Caller: The new address is there. I need no more assistance.

Caller: [inaudible]
Representative: I cannot hear the request.
[call ends]

Caller: [unintelligible speech]
Representative: The connection is too poor to understand.
[call ends]

Caller: My question itself is resolved.
Representative: The instructions say both that a callback is required and that nobody should call. I cannot clarify which applies.

Caller: The service problem is settled.
Representative: Our notes simultaneously require and forbid a follow-up call, and I cannot determine which instruction is valid.

Caller: The address is correct now; the issue is resolved.
Representative: I will still call you tomorrow as promised.

Representative: The contact record is now fixed.
Caller: Yes, that solves the problem.
Representative: I will phone you in the morning to confirm everything.

Caller: Earlier today I could not confirm whether the form arrived.
Representative: We have received it and the receipt is now visible.
Caller: I can see the receipt. That clears it up completely; no more help is needed.

Caller: The form receipt was unresolved when I called.
Representative: The delivery confirmation is available now.
Caller: I have it, so the issue is resolved and there is no follow-up needed.
